project_type: React 19 SPA with TanStack Router/Start, Supabase backend (PostgreSQL + edge functions), deployed to Cloudflare Workers
test_framework: No unit test framework configured. Playwright e2e exists but not relevant for this task.
verification_instructions: 1. Run bunx tsc --noEmit - must pass with 0 errors. 2. Run bun run build - must produce dist/ successfully.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/integrations/supabase/types.ts is auto-generated but we manually update it when adding new tables since we cannot run supabase CLI in this environment.
environment_constraints: No Supabase CLI available - migrations are written as SQL files but cannot be applied/tested. No Docker daemon. Types file must be manually updated to match new tables.
contribution_requirements: Migrations go in supabase/migrations/ with format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_name.sql. RLS must be enabled on all new tables. Use public.is_admin(auth.uid()) for admin access patterns. Use public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'documentation') for documentation role checks.
key_patterns:
- Queries: useQuery from @tanstack/react-query with queryKey and queryFn calling supabase client
- Mutations: useMutation with onSuccess invalidating relevant queryKeys
- Toast: import { toast } from 'sonner'
- Auth: useAuth() returns { user, profile, roles, isAdmin, hasRole }
- Tables: shadcn Table components
- Cards: shadcn Card
- Badges: shadcn Badge
- Select dropdowns: shadcn Select
- Route definition: createFileRoute('/_authenticated/path')({ component: PageComponent })
- Date formatting: date-fns format()
- Currency: toLocaleString('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' })
- RLS: is_admin for admin, assigned_to = auth.uid() for user-scoped, has_role for role-based
relevant_files: src/components/dashboard/new-booking-dialog.tsx (where assign button goes after booking save)
src/components/app-shell.tsx (sidebar nav - already has documentation entry)
directory_structure:
src/routes/_authenticated/ - page routes
src/components/ - reusable components
src/components/dashboard/ - dashboard-specific components
src/lib/ - utilities, auth, constants
src/integrations/supabase/ - client + generated types
supabase/migrations/ - SQL migration files
